memory_bridge: Keep the pig beneath one roof: pull back to include 大家, “everyone,” and 家 is high-level jiā; step softly into 人家, a household, and 家 becomes neutral jia. The wide group shot and quiet interior keep the readings distinct.

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 大家 is a common modern anchor for this distinct reading.
readings.overlay: The roof expands over the pig and the whole community in 大家（dà jiā）, “everyone”; hold jiā high and level across the broad roofline.

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 人家 is a common modern anchor for this distinct reading.
readings.overlay: Step quietly beneath the roof of 人家（rén jia）, “a household”; the final jia is soft and unstressed, like taking off your shoes indoors.
